name: gcloud MCP servers
description: Connect MCP-capable agents to Google Cloud management, observability, storage, and backup tools.
compatibility: MCP clients; Gemini CLI setup; gcloud CLI and Node.js 20 or newer.
limitations: Requires Google Cloud access and credentials; tool operations can change remote resources and incur charges.
A locally running MCP process does not make its cloud operations offline.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
